subject: Request: executive approval for non-standard POC credit & term extension - AtlasAI
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Morris <kate@atlasai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 09:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC timeline & requested runway

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, AtlasAI's ingestion spike last week pushed you past the standard PLG credit window. You asked whether we can provide additional evaluation credits and extend the POC deadline to Feb 28 to validate the LLM reranking workflow end-to-end.

Quick summary of the ask:
- +$12k in POC credits applied to the AtlasAI account
- POC end date extended from Jan 15 -> Feb 28
- Access to a short-lived dedicated routing policy (no SLA) to stabilize latency during peak runs

I don't want to block their momentum going into the new year. Jordan and Marissa — can you confirm whether Deal Desk can approve this as a standard exception? If not, I'm escalating to leadership for one-off approval.

Kate — attaching the usage snapshot we discussed. If you can share the production test plan and the stakeholders who will sign off on success criteria, that will help our internal approval.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

Attachments: POC_usage_report_Q4.csv (csv), redwood-poc-term-sheet-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Kate Morris <kate@atlasai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC timeline & requested runway

Thanks Hannah —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the usage file. Confirming AtlasAI's ask: we need the extra credits and the extended finish date to complete edge-case evaluation and deploy a small internal load test. The key sign-off will be from our Head of Product (Irene Xu) and CTO (Samir Patel).

If Redwood can provide the credit uplift and the extension, we'll commit to a technical deep-dive in week 5 of the POC and share the evaluation report. We can also sign the updated term sheet you attached.

One ask: can you provide a short note confirming that the dedicated routing policy is a temporary, non-SLA change? Procurement will want to include that language.

—Kate
Kate Morris
Director of Partnerships, AtlasAI
kate@atlasai.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for non-standard POC credit & term extension - AtlasAI

Hannah / Jordan —

Quick review from Deal Desk: standard PLG allowances cap POC credits at $5k and extensions up to +30 days without leadership approval. This request (+$12k, +44 days) exceeds both thresholds.

We can fast-track an approval packet for Exec review, but we'll need:
- short justification (ROI, close likelihood, strategic fit)
- updated term sheet with temporary routing policy language (no SLA, revert date)
- sign-off timeline from Atlas (who signs commercial conversion)

Hannah — can you draft a one-paragraph business justification and confirm their conversion sponsor? I'll assemble the packet and route to Aditya for emergency OK.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Exec approval request: AtlasAI one-off POC credit + extension (time-sensitive)

Aditya —

Apologies for the weekend ping. I wanted to get this in your inbox before the week starts: AtlasAI is an early-stage startup building a vertical search product; they evaluated two other vendors but Redwood's latency/cost profile during their tests materially outperformed the alternatives. They are a high-propensity expansion opportunity (expected ARR at conversion: ~$220k, upsell path into dedicated capacity within 9-12 months).

Specific ask: one-time approval for +$12,000 in promotional credits applied to their Hosted account and a POC end-date extension to 2027-02-28. We will not provide any SLA for the routing change — it is temporary and will revert automatically on the extension date. Deal Desk confirms this is outside standard limits.

Why this matters:
- Atlas has already built an integration and plans a funded pilot starting Q2; converting them now removes rework and shortens sales cycle.
- The incremental credit reduces friction and keeps our performance advantage visible during their final evaluation.
- We have verbal buy-in from their CTO and Head of Product who will sign the SOW within 30 days of a successful test.

Proposed guardrails:
- Credit expires if Atlas does not sign a commercial agreement by 2027-04-30.
- Credits applied only to token usage for the POC workspace (no model fine-tuning credits).
- Deal Desk to log the one-off in finance with a column for executive approvals.

I've attached the usage snapshot and the updated term sheet. Marissa has the packet ready for review. If you can approve with a short reply, we can get Procurement moving today.

Thanks and happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

—Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Exec approval request: AtlasAI one-off POC credit + extension (time-sensitive)

Thanks Hannah — and thanks Marissa for the quick analysis.

Approved. Provide the term sheet language that limits the credit and confirms the revert date; Finance to code the $12k as a promotional expense for Q4. Please include the conversion target and review date in HubSpot (I've added a note on the deal record).

Aditya
Aditya Rao
CEO, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
